title: Input symbol after masking
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, $A,S$ be types, $x$ a word over $A$, $z\in A$, and $c$ a configuration on $x$. The symbol read by the input head after replacing the input by the constant word of $|x|$ copies of $z$ is the image of the symbol read by $c$ under the map sending every symbol to $z$ and preserving absence of a symbol.
replaced:
Let $z$ be a symbol and $c$ a configuration of a $k$-tape machine on an input word
$x$. The symbol scanned by the input head of the masked configuration on
$z^{\abs{x}}$ is blank exactly when the symbol scanned in $c$ is blank, and equals
$z$ whenever $c$ scans any nonblank symbol.
